caseName: Idaho Sheet Metal Works, Inc. v. Wirtz
caseNameFull: Idaho Sheet Metal Works, Inc. v. Wirtz, Secretary of Labor
attorneys: T. H. Eberle for petitioner. Solicitor General Cox, Charles Donahue, Bessie Margolin, Robert E. Nagle and Caruthers G. Berger for respondent.

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted limited to Question 2 presented by petition which reads as follows:

“2. Is the employer’s shop a retail establishment and entitled to the exemption as such under Section 13 (a) of the Fair Labor Standards Act?”
